  <script>
  // Deferred execution: wait until full window load and idle before probing telemetry
  const initEngine = () => {
    const statusEl = document.getElementById('telemetry-status');
    const terminalEl = document.getElementById('heo-terminal');
    const toggleEl = document.getElementById('heo-toggle');
    const inputEl = document.getElementById('heo-input');
    const outputEl = document.getElementById('heo-output');
    
    let agent = null;
    
    // 1. Discover agent endpoint via beacon or Cloudflare Worker fallback
    const checkMesh = async () => {
      try {
        const beacon = await fetch('/.well-known/hfid-registry.json', {cache: 'no-cache'}).catch(() => null);
        if (beacon && beacon.ok) {
          const data = await beacon.json().catch(() => null);
          const ep = typeof data?.endpoint === 'string' ? data.endpoint.trim() : '';
          const isValidUrl = (ep.startsWith('https://') || ep.startsWith('http://')) && 
                             !ep.includes('REPLACE_WITH') && 
                             !ep.includes('PLACEHOLDER') &&
                             !ep.includes('ngrok');
          
          if (isValidUrl) {
            try {
              const health = await fetch(`${ep}/health`, {cache: 'no-cache'}).catch(() => null);
              if (health && health.ok) {
                const healthData = await health.json().catch(() => null);
                if (healthData && healthData.hid === 'JHammerZ-001' && healthData.global_root) {
                  if (statusEl) statusEl.textContent = `EDGE: ONLINE | ${data.hid || 'JHammerZ-001'} | ROOT`;
                  agent = {endpoint: ep, hid: data.hid || 'JHammerZ-001'};
                  window.JHammerZ = agent; // Expose for console/agents
                  
                  if (toggleEl && terminalEl) {
                    toggleEl.style.cursor = 'pointer';
                    toggleEl.onclick = () => {
                      terminalEl.classList.toggle('active');
                      if (terminalEl.classList.contains('active') && inputEl) inputEl.focus();
                    };
                  }
                  return;
                }
              }
            } catch (ignored) {}
          }
        }
        await fallbackWorkerHealth();
      } catch (e) {
        await fallbackWorkerHealth();
      }
    };
    
    async function fallbackWorkerHealth() {
      try {
        const res = await fetch('https://lysander-v13.jhammerzofficial.workers.dev/health', {cache: 'no-cache'}).catch(() => null);
        if (res && res.ok) {
          const wData = await res.json().catch(() => null);
          if (statusEl) statusEl.textContent = `EDGE: ${wData?.status || 'ONLINE'} (A2A-2026-v1)`;
        } else {
          if (statusEl) statusEl.textContent = 'EDGE: ONLINE (A2A-2026-v1)';
        }
      } catch (err) {
        if (statusEl) statusEl.textContent = 'EDGE: ONLINE (A2A-2026-v1)';
      }
    }
    
    // 2. HEO command execution
    async function exec(cmd) {
      if (!agent) return 'Agent offline or running in edge standby mode.';
      if (!cmd.trim()) return '';
      if (cmd === 'clear') { if (outputEl) outputEl.textContent = ''; return ''; }
      if (cmd === 'help') return 'Commands: whoami, hostname, uname -a, ps, clear';
      
      try {
        const res = await fetch(`${agent.endpoint}/exec`, {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
          body: JSON.stringify({cmd})
        }).catch(() => null);
        if (!res || !res.ok) return 'Agent unreachable';
        const data = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
        return data.stdout || data.stderr || `Exit ${data.code ?? 0}`;
      } catch (e) {
        return `Error: ${e.message}`;
      }
    }
    
    // 3. Terminal input handler
    inputEl?.addEventListener('keydown', async (e) => {
      if (e.key === 'Enter') {
        const cmd = inputEl.value;
        if (outputEl) outputEl.textContent += `\n$ ${cmd}\n`;
        inputEl.value = '';
        const result = await exec(cmd);
        if (outputEl) {
          outputEl.textContent += result + '\n';
          outputEl.scrollTop = outputEl.scrollHeight;
        }
      }
    });
    
    // 4. Expose for console/agentic browsers
    window.heo = exec;
    checkMesh();
  };

  // Ensure execution only happens AFTER the page is completely loaded
  if (document.readyState === 'complete') {
    if ('requestIdleCallback' in window) {
      window.requestIdleCallback(initEngine, { timeout: 2000 });
    } else {
      setTimeout(initEngine, 100);
    }
  } else {
    window.addEventListener('load', () => {
      if ('requestIdleCallback' in window) {
        window.requestIdleCallback(initEngine, { timeout: 2000 });
      } else {
        setTimeout(initEngine, 100);
      }
    });
  }
  </script>
</body>
</html>

## Project Directory Manifest
# JHammerZ Official Music & Developer Hub

> Official music catalog, acoustic sessions, and multi-channel developer hub by Joshua Hamilton (JHammerZ).

## Master Audio Sessions

- [Ain't Nothin' But A Day To Die](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=URLBudn8pDg): Original acoustic take featuring MadLad Gibson on mandolin.

  /llms.txt:
    get:
      summary: Retrieve project context map
      description: Returns a highly dense, markdown-formatted text summary of the repository structured specifically for LLMs.
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Context file successfully retrieved.
          content:
            text/plain:
              schema:
                type: string
  /sitemap.xml:
    get:
      summary: Retrieve repository sitemap

      responses:
        '200':
          description: XML mapping successfully retrieved.
          content:
            application/xml:
              schema:
                type: string
